description.value:
This metallic sticker adheres to any object.

Activate—Shrink 1 (magic, manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements The applied item is its normal size

Effect The item shrinks to fit in your palm. Its Bulk becomes negligible, and it can be easily @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] in a pocket.

Activate—Grow 1 (magic, manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Requirements The applied item is miniaturized

Effect The item returns to its normal size, appearing in an adjacent space if it's too big for you to hold. You can't Grow the applied item if there isn't enough space for it to appear.
